DrawOWBoarder?.name: Draw border icon and player map sprites
summary: Per-frame overworld sprite drawing. First computes both players' screen positions (CODE_04862E), then draws Mario's regular
sprite at a fixed spot in the border (probably the player icon) plus a 4x4 block of 8x8 tiles ($7E, property $36) at (24,7),
probably its backdrop. The Mario routine is the level one (CODE_00E2BD).
$04862E: hides off-screen players (Y = $F0), applies the sprite offsets (-8, -9; walking poses 5 pixels higher than swimming
ones), draws the current player and, in a two player game on the same submap, the other one with CODE_04894F, and clears their
OAM size bits. $048789: if the player's lives are negative (out of lives), draws a 2-tile marker above the map sprite.
Parameters of $048789: X = OAM offset (0 or $20), [$04] = palette offset, [$8A]/[$8B] = sprite position.

s0487CB.name: Table: player map sprite tiles
summary: 12 poses of $20 bytes: 4 animation frames x 4 tiles (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), each tile = tile number,
property. Index = pose ([$1F13]/[$1F15], always even) * 16 + frame * 8, frame = [$13] bits 3-4. Poses $08, $0A, $0C, $0E and $12
have water tiles $38/$39 instead of legs (swimming). Property $24 = palette 2, priority 2; bit 6 = X flip.

s04894B.name: Table: facing cycle offsets
summary: Offsets into the tile tables used while OW process [$13D9] = $0B: pose $02, $06, $00, $04 (index = [$13] bits 2-3).

s04894F.name: Draw player map sprite (2x2 tiles)
summary: Draws one player's 4-tile map sprite into OAM from DATA_0487CB, or jumps to CODE_048CE6 if the player has a Yoshi.
Parameters: Y = player index * 2, X = OAM offset into $029C (0 first player, $20 second), [$04] = $0000/$0200 palette offset
(Luigi = +1), [$8A]/[$8B] = sprite X/Y, [$06] = X of the left edge. A player out of lives is not animated.

s0489DE.name: Table: Yoshi rider sprite tiles
summary: 12 poses x 2 frames x 8 tiles (tile number, property): two groups of 4 per frame (rider and Yoshi, order varies by pose).
$FFFF = unused slot. Tiles with palette bits 1 ($0200) are Yoshi's and get recolored by DATA_048CDE. Index = pose * 16 + frame * $10.

s048B5E.name: Table: Yoshi sprite X offsets
summary: One byte per tile (8 per frame, 2 frames per pose): X offset added to [$8A]. Index = (pose * 16 + frame * $10) / 2.

s048C1E.name: Table: Yoshi sprite Y offsets
summary: One byte per tile (8 per frame, 2 frames per pose): Y offset added to [$8B]. Same indexing as DATA_048B5E.

s048CDE.name: Table: Yoshi color to palette bits
summary: Word table indexed by Yoshi color - 4 ($04, $06, $08, $0A): palette bits OR'd into the tile word (palette 0-3).

s048CE6.name: Draw player riding Yoshi (8 tiles)
summary: Draws the rider and Yoshi as 8 OAM tiles from DATA_0489DE, with per-tile offsets from DATA_048B5E/DATA_048C1E. Yoshi tiles
are recolored from the Yoshi color; the rider gets the player's palette offset.
Parameters: Y = player index * 2, X = OAM offset, [$0E] = Yoshi color, [$04] = palette offset, [$8A]/[$8B] = position.

s048D74.name: Table: translevels that restart map music
summary: Translevel numbers compared against [$13BF] by CODE_048D91 (11 words). Probably levels with a cutscene or event on completion.

s048D8A.name: Table: map music per submap
summary: Music number written to [$1DFB], indexed by submap 0-6 (main, Yoshi's Island, Vanilla Dome, Forest of Illusion, Valley of Bowser,
Special Zone, Star World).

s048D91.name: Overworld load: reset poses, set music
summary: Called by JSL from the map loader. Resets both players to an idle pose ($02 walking, $0A swimming), runs CODE_048E55, then decides
whether to restart the map music: always when no cutscene is pending, else only if the level is beaten or in DATA_048D74.
Leaves the music alone after beating translevel $18. Music = DATA_048D8A[submap] written to [$1DFB].

s048E49.name: Unused table: map positions
summary: Words $0128, $0000, $0188 (X) and $01C8, $0000, $01D8 (Y), read only by the unused block in CODE_048E55.

s048E55.name: Overworld setup and process 0 (level exit)
summary: $048E55: sets [$0DD6] = player * 4, converts the player's tile to an offset [$04], writes the level name to the stripe buffer,
stores the tile number in [$13C1], then updates the camera, draws the border sprites and runs the tile animation.
The [$0EF7] block ($048EA5-$048EDE) is probably unused: [$0EF7] seems never set outside unreferenced code.
$048EF1 (OW process 0, first entry of PtrsLong04857D): after a level, sets [$0DB1] = 8; at one map spot goes to process $0C;
else marks the level: midway flag if died with [$13CE] set, or beaten (bit 7) and process += 1 on exit. Then updates the camera.

s048F7F.name: Unused table: OW tile numbers
summary: Same bytes as DATA_04E5E6 (yellow-dot water level tiles); nothing references this copy.
